hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def control_worth(ale_before, ale_after, annual_cost):
    net = round(ale_before - ale_after - annual_cost, 2)
    return (net, net > 0)

print(control_worth(20000, 4000, 5000))
print(control_worth(3000, 1000, 2500))
```

hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def control_worth(ale_before, ale_after, annual_cost):
    net = round(ale_before - ale_after - annual_cost, 2)
    return (net, net > 0)

print(control_worth(20000, 4000, 5000))
print(control_worth(3000, 1000, 2500))
```
